items.title: MECH-063 (ii) tonic/phasic dissociation RETEST -- driver-repair letter (probe_warmup cross-arm arm_key + noise_floor reinstall fix for V3-EXQ-963)
items.note: DRIVER-REPAIR LETTER of V3-EXQ-963 (burned id -- probe_warmup cross-arm cache-restore defect confirmed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-963_2026-08-30 silently zeroed the entire TONIC axis, noise_floor_temp_lift_mean=0.0 on all 20 cells). SD-PROBE-WARMUP library repair landed (ree-v3 d614a9c arm_key+type-guard, 8eb832643d assert_arm_regulators_live); this letter supplies the driver-side items its implemented_note names: (i) arm_key= passed to warm_agent so each arm mints its own cache entry and engages the assertion, (ii) symmetric _fresh_regulators() reinstalling BOTH noise_floor and phasic_burst post-warmup (963 only reinstalled phasic -- exactly why phasic survived and tonic did not), (iii) NoiseFloor.get_state() n_waking_calls/last_n_simulation_skips recorded per TONIC-ON cell (closes the autopsy-flagged recording gap). Re-derive brake (MECH-063: 3 prior substrate_ceiling hits) does NOT apply -- the 963 autopsy classified its own defect "standard"/instrument-wiring, fired:false, and explicitly gates a re-test on exactly items (i)-(iii), all supplied here, not a blind letter. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (noise_floor_temp_lift_mean on properly-instrumented TONIC-ON cells at the full 2x2x5-seed grid) is not recorded anywhere -- 963s own run is corrupted-invalid on this axis, 779a/779b predate SD-074/SD-075 warmup+carry -> not recoverable, run. Adopted from a prior session that authored+smoke-tested this script but died (account spend limit) before queueing; this session (metaworker-chip-20260901-963-driver-armkey-noisefloor) independently re-verified: NoiseFloor/NoiseFloorConfig API surface against ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py source, validate_experiments.py --strict (0 non-conforming; 1 advisory config_slice-declaration warning reviewed and judged a false positive -- the flagged constants ARE conditionally declared exactly when their arm flag gates their use, the checker does not trace the if-branches), --dry-run smoke (8/8 cells no crash, correct instrumentation, arm-conditional-regulators assertion fired clean on every cell). Dry-run manifest CONFIRMS the fix: TONIC-ON arms noise_floor_temp_lift_mean=1.0000 (matches NF_ALPHA), TONIC-OFF 0.0000, n_waking_calls populated only on TONIC-ON -- exactly the V3-EXQ-963 defect signature reversed. Toy-scale FAIL/sample_starvation_requeue at dry-run is expected (2 warmup episodes vs real 40; SD-075 convergence gate has not had time to clear) -- documented REACHABILITY section cites V3-EXQ-952s confirmed min-12-vs-bar-10 at full warmup=40. red-team (fable): CONTESTED, 5 findings, 0 BLOCKING -- F1 fixed pre-queue (evidence_direction_per_claim blanket-copied the joint C1-AND-C2 direction onto SD-069, so a C1-only failure would wrongly record weakens against SD-069 even when C2 -- the criterion that actually tests the phasic regulator -- passed robustly; now derives SD-069s direction from C2 alone). F2 (R5 headroom margin not matched to C1s margin), F3 (C2 event-window has no lever-off state-confound control, inherited unchanged from the validated 779 lineage), F4 (env seed=None un-pairs arms within a seed, matches 779bs own validated default), F5 (R1 reachability transfer from 952 is train_mode/stopping-rule mismatched, worst case an honest requeue not a false verdict) reviewed and accepted as low-probability / inherited risk, not code changes.

items.title: MECH-090/ARC-071 AT-tick commit-latch persistence -- E3-reselection short-circuit retest (owed validation, GFLAG-0079)
items.note: Owed retest routed by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-871a_2026-08-03 (GFLAG-0079, evidence/planning/governance_flags.v1.json, status open): validates ree-v3 main 31ed78e (use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit, substrate_queue.json sd_id arc071_e3_reselection_on_committed_program, implemented_validated) against 871a's own prescribed tick-rate-normalised DV, not raw mean segment length. GOV-REUSE-1: checked reanalysis_query.py for n_genuine_commits on MECH-090 substrate_hash b43e0a46.../d10fb38f... (V3-EXQ-855/871a) -- both pre-date the short-circuit flag; decisive readout under use_e3_reselection_shortcircuit=True absent from every recorded manifest -> run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-090 carries 11 counted substrate_ceiling hits, all SD-034 cluster (delayed-reward/decommit-hold, a different mechanism at a different granularity) -- 871a's own autopsy already made and recorded this exact distinction ('not the same question as this run'); this run continues that already-adjudicated lineage, brake does not apply, per the same precedent. Substrate-path overlap (Step 2.5c): two corrupting substrate_queue.json entries (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082) name bare ree_core/agent.py; both confirmed provably inert for this driver (gated on use_external_task_drive / use_lateral_pfc_analog, both default False and never set here) -- see script docstring for the verification. RED-TEAM (fable), two passes per skill's re-spawn-once-on-BLOCKING rule: pass 1 (design: chunk_max_size=2, replaying 871a exactly) returned BLOCKING -- the short-circuit's own continuation condition (_committed_step_idx < chunk_length-1) is mechanically unreachable at chunk_length=2 because the commit tick's own bookkeeping already advances the counter to 1 within the same tick (verified directly against ree_core/agent.py:9591,9757-9759,7214-7218) -- a working fix and an inert fix would read identically. Fixed: chunk_max_size 2->5 (A_HIER_S5, one of V3-EXQ-841's own dose arms, confirmed both seeds 101/505 form length-5 chunks on this schedule), plus a new shortcircuit_opportunity_present readiness precondition. Pass 2 (post-fix design) returned BLOCKING again -- the autopsy's own literal n_genuine_commits/n_e3_ticks denominates over ALL E3 ticks, most of which are not opportunity ticks (the fix's own motivating probe measured only 36.8% premature-reselection among chunk-committed decisions at this size), so even a perfectly working fix could leave the ratio inside the 'working' band -- fix-works and fix-inert would print identically. Fixed: verdict now routes on opportunity_continuation_rate, conditioned only on ticks where continuation was structurally possible (exactly 0.0 pre-fix by 871a's own exact-arithmetic finding); the autopsy's literal ratio is retained as a supplementary diagnostic only. Both findings independently verified against ree_core/agent.py source by this session before being applied (per skill's verify-before-acting instruction), not accepted on the reviewer's say-so. No third spawn -- per the skill's one-pass rule, the second fix was accepted on direct source verification. GOVERNANCE NOTE (report only, not applied by this queueing session): once this run lands, MECH-090's pending_retest_after_substrate (claims.yaml) and GFLAG-0079 are governance dispositions for /governance to apply.
